RWA.note: Help-centre article on ID pre-enrolment; no administrative statistics.

facts.fact: IremboGov's online Single Digital ID adult self-pre-enrolment verifies an applicant against their National ID or NIDA application number by face scan, with a one-time password sent to the registered phone as fallback.

RWA.note: No link between civil register and ID system is described; CRVS registration is only mentioned as a route for people with no documents.
No digital civil register is described.
No count or share of people enrolled is given.
No number at birth is described.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is described.

facts.fact: IremboGov's help article says Rwanda is preparing to roll out a new Digital National ID system and requires pre-enrolment before the official launch, with biometric capture and issue still to follow.

RWA.note: Pre-enrolment is the ID system's own enrolment step; no other system checking against the ID is described.
No local civil registration office entry is described.
